body: User approved reducing the final subset preparation request from 2 CPU/8 GiB to 2 CPU/4 GiB. Local wire conversion is identical except memory; 4 survey tests, lint and Pyrefly pass. CC review f3b8b8a7-5835-483c-8cad-271f12389b1f found no blocker. Original plan 30fc30f1a7e618900a2f1dc40fe5650237b06ea979f2cedfcf8ca664c496114b and all TPU settings unchanged. New parent /calvinxu/tpp10-domain-sweeps-cpu4g. Wikipedia p100 initial training check acquired TPU and loaded first batch; FineMath p100 queued for TPU capacity; remaining26 remain gated on these two checks. No survey endpoint yet. Original survey tree is terminal and leases were cleared before launch. CC found no blocker, four survey tests and lint/Pyrefly/wire checks passed. Handoff, CC change list and scratch monitoring state updated. Existing heartbeat was found PAUSED and its status was preserved while updating the root. Prior Echo publication attempt failed HTTP403; durable research receipts are attached.
title: CPU subset recovery verified; initial survey training released
